correction: A test that finds a rule in a Markdown file is a hand-written reader too, under the same rule: give it a narrow contract that fails closed (decode the bytes as fatal UTF-8, refuse a CR, a BOM and any fence line, the marker on exactly 1 line at column 0, the item ends at the first line without its indent) and test 1 case for each listed shape with its outcome under that contract
evidence: Re-review 1 of frostyard/core#252 (openai/gpt-6.1-sol) at 00fde8b found that the guard took the first line holding a marker, so a fenced example could pass for the real checkbox; re-review 2 at 0904886 found no cases for tilde fences, fences in blockquotes and lists, multi-line code spans and invalid UTF-8; re-review 3 at e59d566 found no closed code span across a line break and no backtick pair across a table cell; fixed in frostyard/core#252
